phases.description: ELI holds HOLLIS's look, quite still

questions.question: 0-0.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - ELI looks at HOLLIS?
0.5-4.7s ACTION: does this happen on screen - ELI speaks to HOLLIS carefully?
4.7-6s HOLD: does this happen on screen - ELI holds HOLLIS's look, quite still?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): ELI speaks to HOLLIS
ELI: does the face/body read as uneasy, watchful (restrained)? Must NOT read as: boredom.
Line 645 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: ELI: It sounded like a warning, Sarge. She said it real calm.
ELI sounds like the voice bible: young, careful male voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC05_g23: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI standing at the counter, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed under HOLLIS's right hand, red seal up; the ledger: lying closed on the counter; the ID card: in HOLLIS's pocket.

Last frame matches state SC05_g24: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI standing at the counter, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed under HOLLIS's right hand, red seal up; the ledger: lying closed on the counter; the ID card: in HOLLIS's pocket.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Corners (all four, full size): any watermark, logo, sparkle or text? Name it and its corner. The known Gemini sparkle bottom-right is recorded, not removed (Owner decision); any other mark fails.
Line 645: does ELI clearly speak to HOLLIS (eyes and body toward them)?
Is the place where HOLLIS stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do ELI's eyes go to frame-left, well clear of the lens?
Does ELI look at HOLLIS and never into the lens?
Do ELI and HOLLIS stay on their own sides (frosted-glass hallway door / counter, staff side and archive shelves) the whole clip?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look.
